title: Ledger and Confession
author: Isandro Okonkwo
blurb: Sable Pemberton, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
